label: Diagram 1.8
caption: Diagram 1.8
description:
Diagram 1.8, titled 'Landings next to doors in dwellings', shows two separate side-on sectional views, labelled 'a.' and 'b.' (though no letter labels are explicitly visible, there are two distinct parts). The text 'See para 1.24' is at the top left.

The first part depicts a staircase with a flight going 'Up' towards a landing. The 'Width of flight' is indicated by a horizontal dimension line with arrows between the two sides of the staircase. Below the flight is a 'Landing'. A 'Door' is shown opening into the space of the landing. A dimension line indicates that the width of the landing area, from the face of the door to the side of the flight, must be 'At least 400mm'.

The second part shows a similar arrangement where a flight goes 'Up' from a landing. In this version, the 'Door' is positioned such that the landing space is located in front of the door. A dimension line indicates the distance from the face of the door to the side of the flight is 'At least 400mm'. The 'Width of flight' is also labelled here.
